claims.text: Morgan Stanley's $2.9T/$1.5T figures are real and traceable to a specific, named report, "Bridging a $1.5tr Data Center Financing Gap"
McKinsey's most commonly cited headline number is $6.7T (or $7T in some framings) of total global data-center capex by 2030; $8T appears only as the upper bound of a $3-8T range
DefiLlama's public API shows USD.AI's TVL at $177.1M as of August 16, 2026, down from a January 1, 2026 peak of $686.9M: a 74.2% decline
USD.AI's own app dashboard shows TVL of $432.4M as of August 21 -- a near-exact match for Arete's $430M
USD.AI's own mid-2026 Lighthouse report discloses $202-205M of loans actually deployed across 13 active positions, with $283M in total collateral value
QumulusAI's own S-1/A discloses just $4.3M drawn against its $500M USD.AI facility as of February 2026
Duos Edge AI grew from a $620,000 loan in July 2025 to a $98.1M facility by June 2026 -- now the single largest position in the book

Bleecker Street Research's April 30, 2026 report alleges Sharon AI's $1.25B anchor contract with ESDS requires roughly $250M/year against ESDS's disclosed FY2025 revenue of $39.9M and a $140M letter-of-credit requirement against ESDS's total assets of $69.5M
Sharon AI reported 212MW of secured AI Factory capacity as of its August 13, 2026 Q2 earnings call, plus new $373M and roughly $950M customer cloud-service agreements
DefiLlama's independently tracked fee data shows trailing-twelve-month fees total approximately $7.0M annualized, roughly a quarter of Arete's cited $30M
CHIP hit a fresh all-time low of $0.02163 on August 9, 2026, 78% below its April 23 all-time high of $0.1402, before a bounce to roughly $0.028-0.031 by August 19-21
No governance proposal addressing the April 21, 2027 CHIP unlock cliff was found as of this writing
Independent sizing of the actual specialist GPU-collateralized private-credit niche comes in around $20-30B, roughly 100x smaller than the '$2T GPU debt middle market' framing implies

Traditional private-credit lenders already serve comparably sized or larger deals in exactly this tier: Upper90 ($225M to Crusoe), Victory Park Capital ($175M), and Macquarie (up to $10B for FluidStack)
The USD.AI-Barker coverage, reinsured through Munich Re's Great Lakes Insurance SE, launched February 6, 2026, structured so an 80%-of-valuation warranty matches the 80% max LTV cap
Both the CHIP thesis's named authors (McKenna and Daveeemor) are Arete Capital personnel, not an independent outside co-author
McKenna has a documented pattern of publishing a bullish public token thesis and later disclosing he personally bought the token off the back of it, on HYPE in October 2025
Independent analyst Pine Analytics valued CHIP's launch FDV at 1.2x Ethena's FDV/TVL multiple and 2.9x Maple Finance's despite far lower loan utilization
